examples.example: Alles in allem ist "Die Verurteilten" ein wahres Meisterwerk des Gefängisdramas und ist für alle Filmfans nur wärmstens zu empfehlen.

category.label: Supreme quality
category.note: Prototypical quality nouns: German Meisterwerk (compound: Meister+Werk) and Russian шедевр (from French chef-d'oeuvre). Both are the highest-frequency quality markers in their respective subcorpora.

category.label: Narrative structure
category.note: German evaluates narrative through Handlung (plot as experienced) and Drehbuch (script as craft object). Russian distributes across сюжет, повествование, and сценарий. The three-way Russian distinction has no direct German parallel.

category.label: Emotional and atmospheric quality
category.note: German has three distinct emotional-atmospheric nouns. Russian concentrates this evaluative dimension primarily in атмосфера.

category.label: Performance and craft
category.note: German reviews explicitly evaluate acting and script quality. No equivalent high-frequency craft vocabulary appears in the Russian subcorpus.

category.label: Meaning and thematic depth
category.note: Russian reviewers evaluate films through existential categories: смысл (meaning), идея (idea), судьба (fate). No German counterparts appear at comparable frequency.

category.label: Review discourse markers
category.note: Metadiscursive verdict markers: German Fazit and Russian итог both frame the reviewer's final evaluation.
